name: se-corporate-tax
description: Swedish corporate income tax (bolagsskatt) for aktiebolag, ekonomiska föreningar and other legal persons resident in Sweden, and for foreign companies with a permanent establishment (fast driftställe) in Sweden. Covers the 20.6% rate under Inkomstskattelagen 65 kap. 10 §, the taxable base, periodiseringsfond (25%, six years, schablonintäkt), inventarier depreciation, tax-exempt dividends and gains on näringsbetingade andelar, the interest limitation rule (30% of tax EBITDA, SEK 5 million), loss carry-forward and the ownership-change restrictions, koncernbidrag, Inkomstdeklaration 2 deadlines, preliminärskatt, kostnadsränta, förseningsavgift, skattetillägg and kupongskatt. Tax year 2026. Trigger on: bolagsskatt, Swedish corporate tax, aktiebolag tax, INK2, periodiseringsfond, koncernbidrag, näringsbetingade andelar, ränteavdragsbegränsning, underskottsavdrag, kupongskatt.
